winner.headline: What hurt is easier to put into words.
winner.body: You can bring a strained conversation back to the part that caused the upset. When you defend every side detail, your reply gets longer and the main question remains unanswered. The side details can wait. Over the next few hours, you can say what hurt and what changed with less second-guessing. You are not restarting the argument by returning to its actual point. Send one direct reply that explains what hurt and ends with the question you need answered.
